name: db — a domain with something real to open
description: Seeds a table, reads a value back into the context, asserts a count, and gates a step on a db-tagged when-condition. No browser, no network, no credentials. Run it with: python stepper/main.py run db_smoke

extra.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sightings WHERE name = ?
